title: Base rate for management promise delivery in Indian IT mid-caps (PERSISTENT, COFORGE, MPHASIS, KPITTECH; Nov 2026)
body: Same-method promise scores for four Indian IT mid-caps (last 6 calls each, Jul-2025 to Nov-2026; Persistent held no Q1FY27 call, its Jun-2026 Nagarro call is used). Weighted delivery (credit, specificity-weighted): PERSISTENT 100.0% (n=4), COFORGE 85.0% (n=10), MPHASIS 58.3% (n=8), KPITTECH 95.5% (n=5). Sector pattern: near-term company-level margin guidance (EBIT/EBITDA bands, quarter-ahead margin walks) is almost always met (pooled margin 97.5%); growth-shape, vertical and timing statements are the weak part (pooled revenue/growth 68.8%, other 82.4%). Most FY27 guidance is still pending and n is small (4-10 scored per company), so the big tests - KPIT's FY27 20.5-21.2% EBITDA guide against a 17.2-17.8% H1, Persistent's USD 2 bn and 16-17% EBIT aspirations, Coforge's raised 16% EBIT, Mphasis's low-double-digit growth - are not yet in the scores. SAC (pts vs leave-one-out peer medians): PERSISTENT +13.9, COFORGE +12.6, MPHASIS -28.5, KPITTECH +6.6. Use: base rates for credibility-generated paper calls (thesis tag credibility-generated, it). Provisional. Research, not advice.

data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled).
